text_block_list.text:
Heading out near the station to pick up a 
book, I bump into Phalaenopsis. 
It seems she was in town to do some 
shopping and catch a film.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is a movie I have had my eye on for 
some time. 
Fortunately, my schedule opened up today.
choice_data_list:
A movie... What kind of film is it, if you 
don't mind me asking?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
It is an adaptation of a book very dear to 
my heart. 
...What, does it pique your interest?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Then if you have no prior engagements... 
will you accompany me?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As for seats... Good, we can still get 
tickets. 
Spending time in such a manner once in a 
while is not half bad.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
It exceeded even my expectations.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: How was the experience for you?

The film was “Gekka Bijin”—a swordsmanship 
tale about a samurai's daughter 
striving to revive her family dojo. We 
thoroughly enjoyed the dazzling action and 
gripping drama.
choice_data_list:
The way she fought, her fierce resolve. 
She was so cool, just like you.

The way she fought, her noble resolve. She 
was truly admirable, just like you.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh, spare the flattery. 
Still—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I, too, was profoundly moved. 
...By that fierce, pure way of life.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Furthermore, I found much to relate to in 
her. 
Her station, as well as her philosophy.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
As well as how she never wavered, staying 
true to her convictions in the face of any 
adversity.
choice_data_list:
I'm really curious to hear more about 
that.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oh? You seem unusually eager. 
Hm, in that case—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—you would do well to read the original 
work.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Do not look so alarmed. 
If you merely wish to better understand 
the film, the first three volumes will 
suffice.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hold on. Did you end up buying every 
single volume?
choice_data_list:
Reading it will help me understand you 
better. It's a chance to learn!

Reading it will help me understand you 
better. It's a chance to learn!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Heh. 
I see.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...They wish to understand my thoughts 
and perspective 
more fully, and on a deeper level... is 
that it?)

After finishing our purchases at the 
bookstore, as we passed 
by a confectionery shop in the same mall—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Oho, Japanese confections. Hm, quite 
pleasing to the eye.

text_block_list.name: Confectionery Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Welcome! 
Care for a treat, young lady?

text_block_list.name: Confectionery Shop Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We've even got products tailored for 
athletes these days. 
These portable yokan bars were just 
released, in fact.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I see... Even with your storied heritage, 
you never neglect self-improvement... 
Admirable.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Yokan is an excellent choice, Trainer. 
It eases fatigue and keeps hunger at bay. 
Even during training—
choice_data_list: Clerk! We'll take your entire stock...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(To learn by emulating my words and 
thoughts. 
That is fine. Good, even, but—)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...Blind faith does not constitute true 
learning. 
If that is the case, I must set them 
straight before long.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(To accomplish great deeds in the days 
ahead, 
one requires a discerning eye to assess 
matters with a cool head...)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: (...Shall I test them, then?)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Hm... I suppose I should pick up some 
sportswear as well. 
That one... and perhaps these over here.
choice_data_list:
...Wait, aren't you going to pick 
something easier to regulate body 
temperature with?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? 
Then tell me, which do you believe would 
be best?
choice_data_list:
For breathability, this one... and for 
moisture absorption, maybe this?

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...I see. 
Very well. We shall go with your 
selection, then.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(As expected of my disciple. —My worries 
were for naught.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
—It is already dusk, I see. 
We had best head back.
choice_data_list:
Looks like there won't be a bus back to 
the academy for a while...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Hm...

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Then we run.
choice_data_list: ...! Is this part of our training too...?!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(...They actually took that to heart? 
Then a bit of teasing may be amusing.)

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. 
One must be prepared to temper mind and 
body at any given moment.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
However, you need not force yourself to 
keep pace. 
You may take your time heading back.
choice_data_list:
N-No way...! A little luggage won't stop 
me...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Oho... what determination in their 
eyes...)
choice_data_list: If I want to grow enough to support you—
If I want to grow enough to support you—

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
choice_data_list:
I have to be able to... handle at least 
this much...!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Ah, no, wait, wait!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: You need not run!

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: ...Forgive me, that was merely a jest.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
I never imagined you would actually start 
running with all those heavy bags. 
It was thoughtless of me. Forgive me.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
...And yet, with who you are now, 
you surely could have foreseen whether it 
was possible in that state.
choice_data_list:
If I don't stay true to my resolve, I'll 
never grow.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Heh... 
Truly—a commendable spirit.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Come now, hand it over.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
Consider it an apology for teasing you. 
Besides... at that pace, the sun will set 
on us.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text: Let us head back.

text_block_list.name: Phalaenopsis
text_block_list.text:
(Indeed, my assessment was not mistaken. 
This one can go so much further—)
